title: Introspective evidence for beliefs is theory-laden

statements.text: If inner observation is as theory-laden as outer perception, what people introspect may be fixed largely by the folk psychological framework, so introspecting beliefs may be like seeing demonic spirits or celestial spheres. Empirical work on the unreliability of introspection supports the suspicion.

sources.locator: section 3.1, 'General Theoretical Problems With Folk Psychology'
sources.quote: “introspecting” beliefs may be just like people “seeing” demonic spirits or celestial spheres
